prompt: Round 2 of 6. The company side proposes (Contract research fits because we need a bounded answer within one year and the researcher has prior contract experienc

content.text:
The company wants contract_research_company_owns, but university ownership is my preference. I need to push for uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence or similar. Also 60-day review is acceptable (my card has 16 publications, latest 2026, so publication matters). The exclusivity of 12 months in cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil production is quite broad.

I'll propose: change ip to company_owns_uni_academic_use (compromise - company gets ownership but uni keeps academic use), and reduce exclusivity to 6 months. That's two fields changed.
